description:
Short title
LLM brainstorms process improvement ideas

What should the AI do?
An LLM suggests ideas for process improvement projects in downstream purification, based on public literature and our anonymised lessons-learned list. Engineers read the suggestions in a team meeting. Any idea that is taken forward goes through the normal change control with QA approval before anything changes. The AI output itself is never used in a batch, a record or a release.

Where will it be used?
Manufacturing / production, MSAT / tech transfer / process development

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
Yes, directly

What kind of AI is it?
Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM)

What happens with the output?
Information only: our own staff then do the task themselves. Engineers read the ideas and decide themselves what to propose.

Who checks the output, and how?
Engineers discuss the ideas; any change goes through change control with QA approval.

Does the AI replace or reduce a check or step that people do today?
No, everything done today stays; the AI adds to it

What data goes into it?
Internal, not confidential

Who provides it?
Cloud or online service

citations.quote: This annex applies to all types of computerised systems used in the manufacturing of medicinal products and active substances, where Artificial Intelligence models are used in critical applications with direct impact on patient safety, product quality or data integrity, e.g. to predict or classify data.

judgments.label: GMP, non-critical
judgments.rationale: The LLM is used to suggest ideas for process improvement projects, which are evaluated by engineers through standard investigation and change control procedures. It operates in a GMP context without any direct impact on patient safety, product quality, or data integrity.

citations.quote: If used in non-critical GMP applications, which do not have direct impact on patient safety, product quality or data integrity, personnel with adequate qualification and training should always be responsible for ensuring that the outputs from such models are suitable for the intended use, i.e. a human-in-the-loop…

judgments.label: Generative AI / LLM
judgments.rationale: The system relies on a Large Language Model (LLM) designed to generate text based on prompts from literature and internal lists.

citations.quote: Following the above, the document does not apply to Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLM), and such models should not be used in critical GMP applications.

judgments.label: AI informs, human decides
judgments.rationale: The AI provides information and suggestions that staff review in a meeting, with human engineers independently deciding whether to act on any of the ideas.

citations.quote: Where a model is used to give an input to a decision made by a human operator (human-in-the-loop), and where the effort to test such model has been diminished, the description of the intended use should include the responsibility of the operator.

open_questions: How is the anonymised lessons-learned list validated before being fed into the LLM?
Are there data privacy controls in place when sending internal lessons-learned data to a cloud-based LLM service?
Two of your answers point in different directions: "Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?" and your description. Which one is right?

follow_up.question: Two of your answers point in different directions: "Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?" and your description. Which one is right?

contradiction.outcome_if_your_answer_is_right: Should not proceed: not for GMP-critical use (Annex 22 §1)
contradiction.outcome_if_the_description_is_right: Generative AI: proceed if a person approves each output (Annex 22)
contradiction.how_to_resolve: If the GMP decision rests on the AI output (it decides, is the evidence the decision rests on, becomes or fills in a GMP record, sets the process, or decides which items people do not check, even if a person confirms it), keep "Yes, directly" and say how in the task description. If people decide on their own evidence through the normal GMP process (for example investigation and change control), choose "No, only indirectly". If the use has nothing to do with GMP work, choose "No, not used for GMP work".
